text:
- **Go implementation only:** Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents no longer contain Python pm. The harness suite tests only Go pm. The Linux server clone now runs Go pm and syncs with GitHub.
- **pm-harness move:** pm-harness tracking now lives in Yeeef/pm, with its full history. The old copy in yeeef-agents is closed.
- **Release and CI checks:** pm published a new release with structured release notes. CI now refuses a pull request or release tag that lacks a changelog entry. The slowest PR check finishes much faster than before.
- **Site and records reads:** The site no longer shows "no such file" errors while git rewrites records. Diagrams stay readable and scroll sideways on phones. Image files kept beside records now appear on the site.
